factoryData.name: moodboard-purity
factoryData.shortDescription: Moodboard aesthetic extraction (palette, tags) + coherence/purity score -> per-app universe
factoryData.description: Runs in-process from raw/moodboard-purity via vis_models.moodboard. Real scoring needs SigLIP2 (google/siglip2-base-patch16-224) in data/huggingface; without it the adapter reports unavailable and build_moodboard falls back to the mock.
